newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Deputy director of Nationalist Party's Taoyuan County committee, Chen Yen-kun, arrested for alleged vote-buying in local farmers association elections
Mineral mines found near Pinglin Tunnel in northern Taiwan
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Nationalist Party Taoyuan Committee deputy director Chen Yen-kun, another official arrested for alleged election bribery
Education ministry mulls banning sweet drinks in primary and secondary schools
LIBERTY TIMES - U.S. forced Taiwan to buy old, soon-to-be-decommissioned Stinger missiles
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Nationalist Party business head to lead trade delegation on secret April visit to North Korea
Transport ministry to supervise top-level personnel, share ownership changes within private mobile phone companies
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - More computer companies planning to have affiliate firms listed in stock market
Top economic planning body worries over rising inventories
